ns2:section.sectionText: This course is designed to introduce students to some of the most important and exciting law school cases. Students will come to understand how the law school classroom works, experience a broad sample of at least 9 different areas of law, and engage with nationally renowned law faculty. This course aims to enhance students' ability to think critically and understand case law. This course meets online July 19, 2021-July 30, 2021, 9:00 - noon, M-F.
